## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the observable problem and what a consumer experiences after this change.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe relevant public API, CLI, profile/session storage or retry-policy changes. Link updated guides or explain why no documentation change is needed. Public declaration changes include TSDoc and regenerated API artifacts.

## Verification

List the exact commands run, their results and the operating systems tested. State checks not run, skipped native-platform cases and whether any live-CLI integration was explicitly performed. Ordinary CI requires no personal AI account.

Follow CONTRIBUTING.md and SECURITY.md; include only synthetic or sanitized examples and logs.
